title: pollbolt
description: AI-native survey & form builder. Manage surveys, responses, analytics, and webhooks.
summary: AI-native survey & form builder. Manage surveys, responses, analytics, and webhooks.
offersHint: AI-native survey & form builder. Manage surveys, responses, analytics, and webhooks. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.pollbolt.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: create_survey
toolsPreview.description: Create a new survey. Returns the survey details including share_url. Supported question types: short_text, long_text, multiple_choice, checkbox, checkbox_list, numeric, star_rating, picture_choice, opinion_scale, date, email, contact_info, poll_question, statement.

toolsPreview.name: list_surveys
toolsPreview.description: List all surveys in your PollBolt account with pagination.

toolsPreview.name: get_survey
toolsPreview.description: Get full details of a specific survey including all questions.

toolsPreview.name: update_survey
toolsPreview.description: Update a survey's title, questions, settings, styles, screens, or logic. Providing questions replaces all existing questions.

toolsPreview.name: delete_survey
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a survey and all its responses.

toolsPreview.name: list_responses
toolsPreview.description: List responses for a survey with pagination and filters. Returns response metadata and answers.

toolsPreview.name: get_response
toolsPreview.description: Get a single response by ID.

toolsPreview.name: submit_response
toolsPreview.description: Submit a response to a survey programmatically. Answers is a map of question_id to answer value.

toolsPreview.name: get_analytics
toolsPreview.description: Get analytics summary for a survey (views, responses, completion rate).

toolsPreview.name: list_media_library_images
toolsPreview.description: List images from the account's media library, including brandkits, uploaded media, logos, and theme backgrounds.

toolsPreview.name: duplicate_survey
toolsPreview.description: Create a copy of an existing survey with all its questions, styles, logic, and screens. Returns the new survey details including share_url.

toolsPreview.name: create_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Register a webhook to receive notifications when survey events occur.

toolsPreview.name: list_webhooks
toolsPreview.description: List all registered webhooks for your account.

toolsPreview.name: update_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Update a webhook's URL, events, active status, or secret.
